items.t: 17 houses sold in Forest Glen, Burnaby at a median of $2,122,000 (middle half $1,825,000 to $2,370,000). A typical house in Forest Glen, Burnaby spent 17 days on the market and closed at 94.3% of the asking price.
In Forest Glen, Burnaby, condos sold at a median of $640,000 across 57 sales, and the middle half closed between $550,000 and $755,000. The median condo sat 38 days and sold for 96.7% of list.
Forest Glen, Burnaby: 13 duplexes sold at a median of $1,504,000, with the middle half between $1,400,000 and $2,119,048. The median duplex took 69 days to sell and closed at 95.5% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Forest Glen compares with the rest of Burnaby South

items.t: Of 13 Burnaby South sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Forest Glen ranks second highest at $2,122,000; the range is $1,465,000 (Greentree Village) to $2,900,000 (Deer Lake). Burnaby Hospital ($2,010,000) sits just below and Deer Lake ($2,900,000) sits just above.

Condos in Forest Glen have the second highest median of 5 Burnaby South sub-areas, $640,000. Central Park BS is lowest at $527,000 and Metrotown highest at $690,000. South Slope ($621,000) sits just below and Metrotown ($690,000) sits just above.

Of 8 Burnaby South sub-areas with 5 or more duplex sales, Forest Glen ranks second lowest at $1,504,000; the range is $1,500,000 (Highgate) to $1,751,800 (Central Park BS). Highgate ($1,500,000) sits just below and Burnaby Lake ($1,558,000) sits just above.
